stories.title: 鏈上研究：九成九 meme 發射後短命，只有約 1% 去到 DEX
stories.title_en: Most Meme Tokens Fade Fast After Easy Launches
stories.summary: ZeruAI 分析 3,374 次近期發射：只有 34 個有機去到 DEX（約 1%）；68.7% 開發者五分鐘內出貨；第 30 日交易活躍跌到 0.8%。
stories.summary_en: ZeruAI analyzed 3,374 recent token launches; only 34 reached a DEX organically (~1.01%). Devs sold within five minutes in 68.7% of cases; activity fell from 7.5% day one to 0.8% by day 30.
stories.why_it_matters: 支持我哋改用 Binance 現貨做模擬：極新鏈上盤勝率極低。AI 揀幣要睇結構同流動性，唔好追發射 FOMO。

stories.title: Pump.fun 推出 Pump Bridge，跨鏈買入快咗、錯誤少 92%
stories.title_en: Pump.fun Launches Pump Bridge for Faster Crosschain Trades
stories.summary: 10 月 21 日上線，取代 Relay；平均完成時間約 3.88s→1.95s，錯誤率大幅下降。
stories.summary_en: Pump Bridge launched Oct 21 as default in-app crosschain buys, cutting errors ~92% and completion time ~3.88s to 1.95s.
stories.why_it_matters: 平台繼續優化「入金→炒 meme」漏斗。我哋實驗仍然避開極新盤，用 CEX 現貨驗證 AI setup。

stories.title: Trader Kimchi 改 bio 掛 @pumpfun，$KIMCHI 急升惹質疑
stories.title_en: Kimchi Partners with Pump.fun Amid $KIMCHI Token Launch
stories.summary: 平台慶祝；代幣一度 $40–44M 市值，單錢包持倉約 75% 受質疑。
stories.summary_en: Pump.fun celebrated; $KIMCHI hit ~$40-44M mcap with reports of ~75% supply in one wallet.
stories.why_it_matters: 名人／KOL 敘事 + 集中持倉 = 高風險。唔好當跟買信號。

stories.title: Solana 炒家炮轟 Pump.fun 變「賭場癌症」
stories.title_en: Solana Memecoin Traders Slam Pump.fun as Cancer to the Space
stories.summary: 每日幾千發射、一日炒完、KOL 推完即崩；有人叫撤出平台改做可持續交易。
stories.summary_en: Critics say thousands of daily launches, day-one-only trading, and KOL dumps turned the space into a casino.
stories.why_it_matters: 情緒對照：鏈上 meme 信任低。我哋用 Binance 公開行情做紙上交易更誠實可量度。

stories.title: Solana「Believe in Something」同 Alpenglow：最終確認快到約 150ms
stories.title_en: Solana Community Rallies Around Believe Message as Alpenglow Ships
stories.summary: 官方貼文引發社群；升級將最終確認由約 12.8 秒大幅縮短。SOL 徘徊 $108 附近。
stories.summary_en: Official 'believe' post coincided with Alpenglow cutting finality toward ~150ms; SOL near $108.
stories.why_it_matters: 基建利好唔等於 meme 即升；對照我哋 SOL 基準同相對強度 setup。

stories.title: Tokenized $META 上 Solana，可 24/7 交易
stories.title_en: Tokenized Meta Stock Launches on Solana Blockchain
stories.summary: Backpack Securities 發行，1:1 實股託管；Jupiter 等接入。
stories.summary_en: Backpack Securities issued tokenized META 1:1 backed; Jupiter and others added support.
stories.why_it_matters: 敘事輪動到 RWA／股票代幣化；meme 資金可能分流，跟買要睇相對板塊而非單幣 FOMO。

stories.title: 交易量淡，交易所轉推預測市場（含 Binance.US）
stories.title_en: Crypto Exchanges Launch Prediction Markets Amid Trading Slump
stories.summary: Blockchain.com、Binance.US 等跟住 Coinbase／Gemini 申請預測市場，補收入。
stories.summary_en: Exchanges including Binance.US seek prediction-market products as spot volumes soften.
stories.why_it_matters: 現貨交投偏淡時，波動同輪動結構會變；AI setup 更要避追已急升幣。

stories.title: Base Meme Summit 今日直播，社群想翻身
stories.title_en: Base Meme Summit Returns with Live Interviews
stories.summary: 10 月 22 日 PT 早上場；TOSHI 等社群造勢。非 Binance 現貨主線。
stories.summary_en: Base Meme Summit Oct 22 ~8:30am PT with interviews and community hype around TOSHI etc.
stories.why_it_matters: 鏈上活動熱點；我哋主數據源仍係 Binance 公開行情，唔跟 Base 熱榜。

stories.title: Pump.fun 九成七炒家蝕錢，內幕同 bundler 賺走
stories.title_en: Pump.fun Memecoin Traders Mostly Lose as Insiders Profit
stories.summary: 過去 30 日鏈上分析：Pump.fun 97% 交易者蝕錢；bundler／團隊賺走大部分。
stories.summary_en: On-chain analysis: ~97% of Pump.fun traders lost over 30 days; bundlers/team captured upside.
stories.why_it_matters: 落倉前要假設你係少數贏嘅人。模擬倉可以用嚟測試，但唔好當真實勝率。
